definitions: The space (usually measured in degrees) between two intersecting lines or surfaces at or close to the point where they meet.
A particular way of approaching or considering an issue or problem.
A position from which something is viewed.
A projecting corner, edge, or part.
A sharp bend in something that is otherwise straight.
examples: The angles of the triangle add up to 180 degrees.
Let's look at the problem from different angles.
The photographer shot the scene from several angles.
The sculpture had many sharp angles.
The road had a series of tight angles.
